pairs.subject: knowledge-registry
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:259 The live loader supplies zero adoption counts without comparing fleet artifacts against the catalog, leaving the required sync states unmeasured.

techniques.evidence: src/features/shared/registry/RegistryFleetSync.tsx:111 Catalog generation and normalized digests exist, but this fleet surface never computes the four comparison states; it explicitly discloses that omission.

src/lib/registry/policy.test.ts:15 Reference-alignment tests use a checked-in fixture and serializer/parser round trips rather than the actual reference declaration, which the technique explicitly identifies as insufficient to detect scaffold drift.

src/lib/registry/layout.test.ts:15 The inspected generator derives seed bytes from the normalized org slug, seeds an empty catalog with a null timestamp and telemetry off, includes CODEOWNERS, and distinguishes spine collisions from later-file collisions.

src/lib/registry/layout.ts:26 The complete seed treats the consumer overlay as the registry marker and emits no neutral root declaration carrying lane paths, specifications and gates; the overlay's reader/writer roles do not supply those contracts.

src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/signals/route.ts:100 The endpoint aggregates signals already imported from registry contributors and republishes their totals under this installation's contributor ID, allowing the same measurements to be counted again.
src/lib/registry/scaffold.ts:87 The automated scaffold opens a GitHub draft PR instead of stopping at a branch commit as the technique explicitly requires; human merge remains required.

src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/signals/route.ts:118 The publication path builds slug-keyed aggregate counts without local evidence fields and rejects path-, URL- and address-shaped payloads before writing.

src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/signals/route.ts:105 Outgoing citation verdicts are copied from mirrored registry signals rather than produced by checking consumer evidence pointers; the inspected sweep ingests maps without generating fresh citation verification.
